source_row.extraction_instructions: Craft CMS card list (li.card-three: heading, date line, category chips); only /events holds live events, /events/p2 and later are archive lists of undated 'last three years' pages and must not be walked. Some cards carry no date (online Basic/Advanced Colposcopy courses) and are dated from their detail page or dropped. Detail pages are free prose with fees/venue in text.

registry_comment: BSCCP: Craft CMS /events card list (page 1 only); Register button kept as organiser_url; trainee OSCE exam skipped
concerns: No fees stored: BSCCP pages carry no fees; each Register button goes to Eventbrite / medcpduk.com / lrctc.org.uk / the EFC congress site, kept as organiser_url for the explorer to follow (Eventbrite may not be readable). Only the trainee OSCE exam (GBP 350) states a fee, and it is skipped as an exam, not a CPD event.

Skipped by design: 'BSCCP Online Colposcopy OSCE 2027' (exam sitting) and the two undated on-demand 'ONLINE Basic/Advanced Colposcopy Course' pages (external colposcopycourses.com). The 2026 Cork annual meeting is past. /events/p2+ are undated 'last three years' archive lists, hence MAX_PAGES=1; if BSCCP ever fills page 1 and moves live events to p2 the cap must change.

The annual meeting detail page still opens with 2026 boilerplate ('finalising arrangements for the 2026 Annual Scientific Meeting'); the description is taken from the 2027 paragraph instead. Venue/city for it come from prose ('in London , QEII Centre').

Coverage checklist: multi-day ranges ok ('19th - 21st April 2027', '14-17 October 2026'); external Register links captured; no PDFs or image fee tables; 'suitable for reaccreditation' text is not stored as CPD points.
